adjudication.finding: Bibliographic shorthand parsing uses a literal-s split and both omits valid whitespace/modifier forms and admits invalid targets. The analyzer contradicts its own oracle on bounded examples.
Mismatched closes leave stale same-name openings, allowing later closes to remove live processed-code state. The source-state relation is not total or transactionally correct.
Ordinary pre blocks, Bikeshed datablocks, explicit l exceptions, and document-level shorthand settings are not modeled. References and headings are fabricated inside opaque or disabled regions.

Manual autolinks, heading definition carriers, and nearest-ancestor inherited definition attributes are absent, so a generated occurrence ledger would be incomplete even when emitted rows are locally correct.
Raw attribute spelling is used as semantic href and definition-scope value. HTML character references are not decoded before URL or scope resolution; both analyzer and oracle share the defect.
Operation-ledger authority accepts arbitrary nonempty review status, and analyzer collision reporting does not cover the union stable-ID namespace. Rejected rows can be admitted as operations.
Heading and operation ownership are not container-nesting-aware. A globally preceding heading remains owner after its nested section has closed.
Setext underline lines can be reused as subsequent heading content; definition separator whitespace semantics and uppercase URL schemes also diverge or share untested common modes.

The separately authored oracle duplicates source-state, attribute, reference, carrier, ownership, and ledger policies closely enough to accept multiple demonstrated defects. File separation is not semantic independence.

The qualification path retains uncounted repeated scans and output-sensitive relations, and malformed option objects can throw. Repair2 provides bounded research evidence, not a safe full-corpus launcher or resource proof.

retained_green_facts: The exact repair2 subject and 14,468-byte stdout replay identically from the workspace and /tmp.
Previously reproduced Unicode raw-close, duplicate interval, direct owner-equality, and disposition-totality cases remain repaired on the sealed subject.
The bounded 18 V9, 29 inherited, 26 counterexample, 16 mutation, 512 arbitrary-byte, and seven geometric-family rail is useful regression evidence only.
next_generation_law: Repair the exact reproduced cases without running the 168-source corpus.
Model Bikeshed source states, container nesting, carrier inheritance, and parsed attribute values from an independently reviewed semantic contract.
Use an oracle derived from that contract or an authenticated independent witness, not a second implementation of the analyzer's policies.
Count analyzer and verifier work separately, eliminate repeated qualification scans, and define the option-input/no-throw boundary.
Only a twice-ACCEPTED subsequent exact subject may seed a reviewed normative operation ledger and then the full source traversal.
